subject: rc
title: RC.------VT.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-14. In UPB(II)-10 Braxton argues that race is 'directly related to the spread of people on the physical universe level, as well as the addition of given cosmic multi-ingredients (or vibrational alignments)' — and, on the pages around this diagram, that the *concept* of race must be carefully distinguished from any one-dimensional or hierarchical reading. (C)RC — the *concept* of race, marked with the (c) prefix to insist it is conceptual not essential — is crossed with VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). The diagram poses that race-as-concept is structurally crossed with vibrational dynamics, but only as a downstream-of-multi-factors claim. Besides the main line to VT-DY, two branches leave RC. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) carries AF-DY (affinity dynamics), which branches to POST (postulation) and MT-INFO (multi-information). PHY-U-C (physical universe context) carries MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) → POL-DY (political dynamics).
